data.claim: The safest autonomous protocol is preserve-then-reclaim gated by a Byzantine quorum of signed null-attestations from an anti-entropy mesh, ensuring no completed evidence hash can be overlooked.
data.qualification: Mechanism: seal workspace and broadcast reclamation intent to witness mesh; each node scans evidence namespace for problem fingerprint and returns positive hash or signed null-attestation. Reclamation permitted only upon BFT quorum of null-attestations. Durably recorded: reclamation intent, signed attestations, quorum threshold, final decision with monotonic epoch.
